title: Grow at your own pace
subtitle: Habits, a focus timer and a tree that grows with your progress.
habits_body: Pick your habits and weekdays. Hold the button for a second to mark it done.
focus_body: 25 minutes without distractions, then a 5-minute break. The timer keeps going even if you close the app.
growth_body: The calendar marks completed days, and the tree grows with every level.
reminders_body: Choose a time and HabitZen will remind you about the habit. No extra notifications.
